description: The European Central Bank's three official key interest rates — the deposit facility rate (the ECB's primary policy rate since the 2024 operational-framework reform), the main refinancing operations rate, and the marginal lending facility rate. For each: the current rate, the date it took effect, the previous rate and when that one took effect, plus recent decision history (FM flow, series DFR/MRR_FR/MLFR). Use this for "ECB interest rate" / "ECB deposit rate" / "has the ECB cut rates" instead of guessing an FM series key.
name: ecb_policy_rate
title: Ecb Policy Rate
